overall_summary: Bitcoin is under near-term pressure from persistent ETF outflows, large miner sales, and hawkish Fed hike talk that could keep the dollar firm. Institutional buys and regulatory wins like Coinbase’s trust charter provide some offset, yet they look secondary for now. Mixed geopolitics and an unclear CPI print leave crypto in a cautious, defensive tone.
key_points: ETF outflows extend to seventh day
MARA dumps large BTC for cash
Fed Waller open to December hike

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed Another $201M; IBIT Hits 7 Straight Outflow Days
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded two hundred one million dollars in net outflows on Monday, with BlackRock's IBIT alone seeing over two hundred thirteen million leave. That extends IBIT's streak to seven consecutive redemption sessions totaling about one point six six billion. Traders should care because persistent institutional outflows remove a key demand bid and keep pressure on Bitcoin near the seventy-four to seventy-five thousand zone even as stocks rebounded.
items.impact: Sustained selling pressure and weaker near-term support for BTC price

items.title: Fed's Waller Backs December Hike, Eyes 50bp if CPI Hot; BTC Slips
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he supports a twenty-five basis point rate hike in December even if October inflation cools, and would consider fifty basis points if core CPI comes in around zero point three percent or higher. Markets now price a December hike at over ninety-five percent odds. Bitcoin slid toward seventy-four thousand as the comments landed ahead of today's CPI release. Traders need to watch because higher-for-longer rates typically squeeze risk assets like crypto.
items.impact: Raises odds of tighter policy, pressuring BTC and risk assets into the data

items.title: MARA Dumps 13,597 BTC for $1.1B, Repays Loans, Eyes More Sales for AI
items.summary: Bitcoin miner MARA Holdings sold thirteen thousand five hundred ninety-seven BTC after the third quarter for roughly one point one billion dollars at an average near eighty-one thousand. It used seven hundred fifty million to fully repay bitcoin-backed loans, freeing collateral, and signaled plans for further sales to fund AI data centers, debt, and possible buybacks. This matters because a major miner is adding substantial supply to the market while pivoting away from pure HODL.
items.impact: Increases near-term BTC supply overhang from a large corporate holder

items.title: Strategy Buys Another 1,036 BTC for $82M; Holdings Top 850,000
items.summary: Michael Saylor's Strategy acquired one thousand thirty-six more bitcoin for about eighty-two million dollars between early and mid-November, pushing total holdings above eight hundred fifty thousand BTC or over four percent of supply. The buy was funded via stock sales and came alongside preferred share repurchases. Traders should note this as continued aggressive corporate accumulation that absorbs some of the ETF and miner selling.
items.impact: Provides a steady institutional bid and positive accumulation signal

items.title: Coinbase Wins Final OCC Approval for National Trust Bank Charter
items.summary: Coinbase received final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to operate Coinbase National Trust Company, upgrading its earlier conditional green light. The charter focuses on institutional crypto custody under federal oversight and does not allow retail deposits or lending. This is important because it deepens crypto's integration into traditional banking rails and could expand Coinbase's custody and payments footprint for big clients.
items.impact: Boosts institutional credibility and custody infrastructure for crypto

items.title: NYSE Picks Avalanche to Settle Tokenized Stocks on 24/7 Platform
items.summary: The New York Stock Exchange selected Avalanche as the exclusive blockchain ledger for clearing and settling trades on its planned twenty-four seven tokenized securities platform. The venue aims for launch later this year pending approvals and will support equities issued across chains while settling on Avalanche. AVAX jumped on the news. Traders care because this is a concrete TradFi adoption win that puts a major public blockchain at the center of Wall Street infrastructure.
items.impact: Positive catalyst for AVAX and broader crypto tokenization narrative

items.title: US October CPI Drops Today; No YoY Figures Available
items.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the October Consumer Price Index at 8:30 a.m. Eastern. Economists expect a 0.3 percent month-over-month rise in the headline and 0.2 percent for core, slower than September's hot print, helped by lower gasoline. Year-over-year numbers will not appear because of missing data from last year's government shutdown. Traders should care because this is the last major inflation reading before the December Fed meeting and will drive rate-hike odds, yields, the dollar, and risk assets including Bitcoin.
items.impact: High volatility; cooler print could ease hike bets while hotter core would reinforce them

items.title: Fed's Waller Backs December Hike, Open to 50bp Move
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in a London speech that he leans toward supporting a quarter-point rate increase at the December FOMC even if today's CPI cools as expected. If core CPI comes in at 0.3 percent or hotter, he believes a half-point hike should be considered to protect the Fed's credibility. Inflation remains too high and is broadening, he argued. Crypto and equity traders need to watch this because it locks in a hawkish baseline and raises the risk of a larger tightening move that would pressure risk assets.
items.impact: Lifts December hike probability and potential size, supporting yields and the dollar

items.title: BLS Omits Year-Over-Year CPI Data Due to Shutdown Gap
items.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics confirmed it will not publish the usual 12-month percent changes for October CPI or core CPI. Last year's federal government shutdown blocked collection of October 2025 price data, so there is no base for the annual comparison. Month-over-month figures will still be released. This matters for traders because the headline annual inflation number is what the public and many models focus on; its absence forces markets to lean harder on the monthly core reading and Fed commentary for policy clues.
items.impact: Adds uncertainty to inflation narrative and market interpretation of the print

items.title: NY Fed Survey: Inflation Expectations Steady, Job Fears Spike
items.summary: The New York Fed's October Survey of Consumer Expectations showed one-year inflation expectations unchanged at 3.9 percent, with three-year at 3.3 percent and five-year at 3.0 percent. But the mean probability that unemployment will be higher in a year jumped to its highest since April 2020. Job-finding expectations improved. Stable long-run inflation expectations are a positive for the Fed, yet rising job worries could eventually soften the labor market and complicate the higher-for-longer rate path that markets are pricing.
items.impact: Supports Fed vigilance on inflation while flagging potential labor softening ahead

items.title: Dollar Holds Near 101.70 as Markets Await CPI and Fed Path
items.summary: The US Dollar Index is trading around 101.70 after slipping from recent highs near 102.30. Support comes from strong October jobs data that pushed December rate-hike odds above 80 percent and from lingering geopolitical risk. Ten-year Treasury yields hover near 4.88 percent. A firm dollar and elevated yields typically weigh on Bitcoin and other risk assets by tightening financial conditions, so today's CPI reaction will decide whether the greenback resumes its climb or gives back ground.
items.impact: Stronger dollar and yields pressure crypto and equities until CPI resolves

items.title: Treasury Auctions $42 Billion 10-Year Notes After CPI
items.summary: The US Treasury will sell 42 billion dollars of new 10-year notes at 1 p.m. Eastern, about four and a half hours after the CPI release. Demand metrics, the stop-out yield, and tail versus when-issued will be scrutinized for signs of buyer fatigue at current rate levels. Weak demand or a high clearing yield would push longer-term rates higher and reinforce the hawkish backdrop. Bond-market stress feeds directly into crypto via higher discount rates and tighter liquidity.
items.impact: Auction outcome can amplify or mute the CPI-driven move in yields

items.title: Trump: Iran War Militarily Over, Strikes Unlikely
items.summary: President Trump declared the war with Iran militarily effectively over after meeting Qatar's prime minister, saying further US strikes are quite unlikely while keeping the Hormuz blockade. Oil prices extended sharp declines, with Brent dropping toward or below ninety dollars, the lowest since late August. Traders should care because this removes a major geopolitical risk premium that has driven energy costs and inflation higher for months, supporting risk assets including crypto if de-escalation holds.
items.impact: Lower oil and reduced Middle East risk premium favor risk-on markets

items.title: Ukraine-Russia-US Peace Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: US-mediated trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine and American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner began in Abu Dhabi, the first substantive round since February after a nine-month pause. Officials noted some private flexibility on territorial issues while focusing on security guarantees, though public red lines remain far apart and Europe is largely excluded from the main table. Crypto traders should watch because a credible path to ending the long war could ease European energy and security risks and support broader risk appetite.
items.impact: Potential de-escalation catalyst but unresolved gaps limit immediate clarity

items.title: China Extends Rare Earth Export Controls Pause
items.summary: China's commerce ministry extended the suspension of expanded rare earth, industrial diamond and lithium battery technology export controls by two months until January tenth twenty twenty-seven. The move preserves part of the prior US-China trade arrangement ahead of the APEC summit and possible Trump-Xi meeting. This matters for markets because rare earths are critical for tech, EVs and defense supply chains; relief reduces a key trade-war flashpoint and supports semiconductor and industrial equities that often correlate with crypto risk sentiment.
items.impact: Eases critical minerals supply fears and supports tech and risk assets

items.title: Houthis Strike Saudi East-West Oil Pipeline
items.summary: Saudi Arabia reported an attack on its critical East-West oil pipeline in the Medina region that caused a limited fire which was extinguished, with operations unaffected and no casualties. The Iran-aligned Houthis have claimed multiple recent strikes on Aramco facilities and infrastructure as regional fighting intensifies alongside the broader Iran conflict. Energy traders and crypto desks care because this pipeline is a key Hormuz bypass route carrying millions of barrels; repeated hits keep a floor under oil volatility and geopolitical risk.
items.impact: Sustains energy infrastructure risk and oil price volatility

items.title: Massie Files Impeachment Articles Against Hegseth
items.summary: Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, centered on waging the Iran war without congressional authorization and other alleged abuses including operations in Yemen and Venezuela. A House vote could come this week in the lame-duck session after Democrats won the midterms. Political instability around war leadership adds uncertainty for defense and energy-linked assets, though conviction remains unlikely; markets dislike Washington drama that could complicate foreign policy.
items.impact: Adds US political noise around Iran policy with limited immediate market direction

items.title: US Evacuates Aircraft from UK Base Over Iran Threat
items.summary: The US military relocated multiple refueling tankers from RAF Mildenhall in Britain after an Iran-linked threat, raising the force protection level at Mildenhall and nearby Lakenheath to Charlie. This follows an earlier withdrawal of bombers from another UK base over a suspected Iran-linked incident. Despite Trump's de-escalation rhetoric, residual Iranian retaliation risks keep a geopolitical overhang on markets and shipping security that can quickly reverse risk-on moves in oil and equities.
items.impact: Highlights lingering Iran retaliation risk despite peace signals
